summary: The `@[simp]` evaluation lemmas only match arguments already written as an isomorphism image, so they do not evaluate the equivalence on arbitrary edges. The simple-graph Kőnig corollary asks for a multigraph Finset bipartition where a simple-graph `IsBipartiteWith` hypothesis is the usable interface.
